verification.windowsNative: Eight native executable test groups; actual 125% system DPI and 100% CI DPI, six pages in three locales, effective window bounds, native updater subprocess result, installer extraction/install/rollback/restart guards.
verification.macos: Apple Silicon and Intel builds, native calendars/optional dates/month-end estimates, three-locale page bounds and resize checks. Actual DMG replacement, new-version native acknowledgement and unchanged saved settings passed on both isolated runners.
verification.browser: 45 screenshots: 320/390/480 pixels, three locales, full/partial/empty/stale/offline, mocked bridge; rail protection tests at zoom 1/1.25/1.5/2 and 360/1280 widths passed.
verification.planDetection: Current verified desktop official usage menu returned Pro in a live read-only probe; menu restored and saved membership untouched. Exact source labels only; ambiguity and manual locks covered.
verification.updateFeed: Pinned Ed25519 signature; three target release sizes and hashes verified. Live current 0.13.1 returned available=false; prior 0.13.0 returned available=true and ready=true after verified full Windows download. Chinese notes rendered as three separate numbered lines.
verification.packages: Six actual CI package/source bytes matched published GitHub asset size and SHA256.

limitations.planDetection: Official supported quota-source labels only. Unknown remains unknown; purchased price tier and dates are never inferred.
